verdict.rationale: The evidence shows generic saved tasks (reusable input configurations), an MCP server for AI agents, and structured dataset exports. None of it documents a preset tuned for research agents that returns citable, source-attributed output. Generic tasks and the MCP integration are adjacent building blocks, not the named capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can apply a preset configuration tuned for research agents that returns structured, citable output
